summary: Stellantis marque DS Automobiles is the title partner (team name). Ten further partners per the club's own Season 12 partner roster on dspenske.com (cross-checked against its Season 12 partners press kit, Dec 2025): TotalEnergies, PMC, Mouser, Molex, KYOCERA AVX, TTI, Syensqo, Yahoo, NEOM-SRMG, Lockton.
